monitors.name: Council of Europe AI Convention Treaty Office status
monitors.sourceLabel: Council of Europe Treaty Office, CETS No. 225
monitors.currentAppClaim: CETS No. 225 has 20 signatures not followed by ratification and one ratification/accession by the EU; Albania signed on 15 June 2026, and the treaty is not yet in force because five ratifications including at least three Council of Europe member states are required.

expectedValues.label: ratifications/accessions
expectedValues.recommendedAction: Review ratified participation rows and the convention in-force caveat.

expectedValues.label: signatures not followed by ratifications
expectedValues.pattern: Total number of signatures not followed by ratifications\s*\|\s*(\d+)
expectedValues.recommendedAction: Review signed participation rows for CETS No. 225.

manualReviewPatterns.label: JavaScript-only Treaty Office shell
manualReviewPatterns.pattern: You need to enable JavaScript to run this app
manualReviewPatterns.recommendedAction: Open the Treaty Office page manually or with a browser-rendered checker and compare signatures, ratifications, and entry-into-force status.

manualVerification.observedStatus: Manual review of the official Council of Europe Treaty Office confirms the current app claim: Treaty 225 has 20 signatures not followed by ratification, 1 ratification/accession, Albania signed on 15 June 2026, the EU ratified on 15 May 2026, and the treaty is not yet in force.
evidence: Council of Europe Treaty Office CETS No. 225 status reviewed 17 August 2026 reports 20 signatures not followed by ratifications, 1 ratification/accession, and entry into force requiring 5 ratifications including at least 3 Council of Europe member states.
Council of Europe AI news page states that the European Union ratified CETS No. 225 on 15 May 2026.
Council of Europe Treaty Office records Albania's signature on 15 June 2026.
The app's signed participation rows include the European Union, but the derived signature-only count removes the EU because the separate ratified row records its 15 May 2026 ratification.
manualVerification.recommendedAction: No repo action needed until 2026-11-15 unless the Treaty Office page shows a newer signature, ratification, or entry-into-force status.

monitors.name: EU AI Act and AI Omnibus status
monitors.sourceLabel: European Commission - AI Omnibus enters into force
monitors.currentAppClaim: The AI Omnibus entered into force on 27 July 2026; most AI Act provisions began applying on 2 August 2026, while high-risk-system deadlines follow the timeline changed by the Omnibus.

changeSignals.label: further application-timeline changes
changeSignals.recommendedAction: Review the AI Act milestones and high-risk-system caveats if the Commission announces another application-timeline change.

manualVerification.observedStatus: Manual review of official European Commission pages confirms that the AI Omnibus entered into force on 27 July 2026 and that most AI Act provisions applied from 2 August 2026, with changed deadlines for high-risk AI systems.
evidence: European Commission AI Omnibus announcement states that the Omnibus entered into force on 27 July 2026.
European Commission Navigating the AI Act FAQ identifies 2 August 2026 as the broad application milestone.
The Commission sources distinguish broad application from the high-risk-system deadlines changed by the AI Omnibus.
manualVerification.recommendedAction: No repo action needed until 2026-11-15 unless the Commission publishes a newer AI Act or AI Omnibus application timeline.
